description_en: Adds an input to a MediaConnect Flow instance
kebab_example: aliyun ice add-media-connect-flow-input --flow-id 34900dc6-90ec-4968-af3c-fcd87f231a5f --input-protocol RTMP-PUSH --input-name AliTestInput --max-bitrate 2000000 --cidrs 19.168.1.1/32,18.168.1.1/16 --input-from-url rtmp://pull.test.alivecdn.com/live/alitest --pair-flow-id 805fbdd0-575e-4146-b35d-ec7f63937b20 --pair-output-name AliTestOutput --srt-latency 1000 --srt-passphrase BETTERG08S01 --srt-pbkey-len 32 --with-internal-vip example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddMediaConnectFlowInput

parameters.help_en: Maximum bitrate in bits per second (bps)
parameters.name: max_bitrate

parameters.help_en: IP address whitelist in CIDR notation. Separate multiple CIDR blocks with commas
parameters.help_zh: IP白名单，CIDR格式，多个IP段之间用,分割
parameters.name: cidrs

parameters.help_en: Input URL. Required only when the input type is RTMP-PULL or SRT-Listener
parameters.help_zh: 输入URL，仅当输入类型是RTMP-PULL/SRT-Listener时必填
parameters.name: input_from_url

parameters.help_en: Upstream Flow ID. Required only when the input type is Flow
parameters.help_zh: 对端FlowId，仅当输入类型是Flow时必填
parameters.name: pair_flow_id

parameters.help_en: Upstream Flow output name. Required only when the input type is Flow
parameters.help_zh: 对端Flow的输出名称，仅当输入类型是Flow时必填
parameters.name: pair_output_name

parameters.help_en: SRT latency in milliseconds. Required only when the input type is SRT-Listener or SRT-Caller
parameters.help_zh: SRT延迟，仅当输入类型是SRT-Listener/SRT-Caller时必填
parameters.name: srt_latency

parameters.help_en: SRT encryption key. Required only when the input type is SRT-Listener or SRT-Caller
parameters.help_zh: SRT加密密钥，仅当输入类型是SRT-Listener/SRT-Caller时必填
parameters.name: srt_passphrase

parameters.help_en: SRT encryption key length in bytes. Required only when the input type is SRT-Listener or SRT-Caller
parameters.help_zh: SRT加密长度，仅当输入类型是SRT-Listener/SRT-Caller时必填
parameters.name: srt_pbkey_len
